title: Reasoning with OmniThought: A Large CoT Dataset with Verbosity and Cognitive Difficulty Annotations
authors_zh: Wenrui Cai、Chengyu Wang、Junbing Yan、Jun Huang、Xiangzhong Fang
paper_type_zh: 多教师 CoT 数据发布、验证与元数据条件选择配方
best_for_zh: 构建或审计推理蒸馏数据、按模型能力选择轨迹、设计偏好对或 RV/CD 奖励的研究者
one_line: OmniThought releases nested multi-teacher math, code, and science traces with separate reasoning-validity and answer acceptance signals plus RV/CD annotations, while row-level prompt provenance, generation settings, executable verifier assets, and exact nested-trace lineage remain incomplete.
OmniThought 发布 708,009 个问题行及其嵌套的多教师数学、代码与科学 CoT，分别保留推理有效性、答案接收信号和 RV/CD 标注；但逐行题源、生成设置、可执行验证器资产与精确轨迹 lineage 仍不完整。
why: It turns trace length, judged cognitive difficulty, teacher identity, and final-answer validity into inspectable construction variables for SFT, preference data, and RL rewards, making it a useful open-recipe case with clear audit boundaries.
inclusion_reason: A large official multi-teacher reasoning release that exposes a nested trace object, separate answer and process judgments, RV/CD metadata, capacity-conditioned selection, and SFT/DPO/GRPO studies, while leaving important provenance, verifier, generation, and snapshot-audit fields unresolved for the Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Published as an ACL 2026 long paper, OmniThought addresses a data-selection problem that final-answer filtering alone cannot solve: multiple chains of thought can reach an accepted answer, yet differ in logical validity, unnecessary verbosity, method difficulty, teacher style, and suitability for a particular student model. The work asks how to build a large, multi-domain, multi-teacher trace pool and make those differences explicit enough for post-training selection.

The released object is nested. One outer row contains a question; its reasoning list contains multiple candidate records with the trace, final solution, full response, teacher identity, a reasoning-validity boolean, and Reasoning Verbosity (RV) and Cognitive Difficulty (CD) score objects. At pinned revision 274ec6417efb435421fb222319d1bb47291ea69b, the official README metadata declares 708,009 rows in one train split. The paper reports more than two million nested CoTs and at least two accepted candidates per retained problem, but the exact nested total has not been independently counted from the full 24.2 GB download.

The decision boundary matters. Final-solution validity governs retention, while logical-process validity is stored separately; an answer-correct trace may remain even if the reasoning judgment is negative. RV/CD are holistic, judge-dependent metadata rather than correctness proofs or step labels. Code candidates use execution tests, whereas math and science use rule checks combined with model judgment. The corresponding runner, tests, answer rules, and per-candidate verifier evidence are not released.

For the atlas, OmniThought is a construction-and-release case rather than a model leaderboard entry. It exposes source families, a nested data object, validator prompts, score definitions, selection equations, and SFT/DPO/GRPO studies, while leaving row-level prompt provenance, generation settings, verifier replay, rejected candidates, and selected-subset lineage unresolved.

OmniThought 以 ACL 2026 长文发表，处理的是一个仅靠最终答案过滤无法解决的数据选择问题：多条思维链可能得到被接收的答案，却在逻辑有效性、不必要的冗长、方法难度、教师风格以及与特定学生模型的适配性上不同。该工作试图构建一个大规模、跨领域、多教师的轨迹池，并把这些差异显式化，以支持后训练选择。

公开对象采用嵌套结构。一个外层行包含 question；其 reasoning 列表包含多条候选记录，字段包括推理轨迹、最终解答、完整回答、教师身份、推理有效性布尔值，以及 Reasoning Verbosity（RV）和 Cognitive Difficulty（CD）评分对象。在固定 revision 274ec6417efb435421fb222319d1bb47291ea69b 上，官方 README 元数据声明单一 train split 有 708,009 行。论文报告嵌套 CoT 超过两百万条，并称每个保留问题至少有两条被接收候选；但本卡没有从 24.2 GB 完整下载中独立计算精确嵌套总数。

判定边界非常重要。最终解答有效性决定是否保留，而逻辑过程有效性另行存储；因此，即使推理判断为负，只要答案正确，轨迹仍可能被保留。RV/CD 是依赖 judge 的整轨元数据，不是正确性证明或步骤标签。代码候选使用执行测试，数学和科学则结合规则检查与模型判断；相应的 runner、测试、答案规则和逐候选验证证据均未发布。

对本图谱而言，OmniThought 是数据构造与发布案例，而不是模型排行榜条目。它披露了来源族、嵌套数据对象、验证提示、评分定义、选择公式以及 SFT/DPO/GRPO 研究，同时仍缺少逐行题源、生成设置、可重放验证器、被拒候选和训练子集 lineage。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is a trace pool in which answer acceptance, judged reasoning validity, teacher identity, and two process descriptors remain distinct variables. The paper then selects traces for a target model from the RV-CD space instead of treating every answer-correct CoT as interchangeable.

| Contract element | Released or reported object | |---|---| | Outer unit | One question row | | Nested unit | One record in the row's reasoning list | | Trace content | thought, solution, and their full_response concatenation | | Generator metadata | teacher; final ACL paper names DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-R1-0528, and QwQ-32B | | Process judgment | thought_correctness_verify, derived from a prompt that evaluates reasoning and solution independently | | RV object | level 0-9 and judge; paper's final RV blends judge score and normalized token length with alpha=0.5 | | CD object | level 0-9 and judge, describing the competence needed to reproduce the method | | Release layout | 708,009 outer rows, one train split, 135 Parquet shards, Apache-2.0 repository metadata | | Not present | Prompt source/domain, rejection reason, verifier trace, generation settings, run ID, split beyond train |

The feedback contract has four layers. First, code execution or hybrid math/science validation decides final-answer acceptance. Second, the logical validity of the reasoning is recorded separately and does not control retention. Third, QwQ-32B supplies holistic CD and judge-side RV scores, with length also entering final RV. Fourth, downstream experiments transform these annotations into selection probabilities, verbosity preference pairs, or learned scalar reward terms.

This separation prevents several category errors. A thought_correctness_verify=true trace is not a step-level proof; an RV/CD difference is not a correctness preference; a dataset row is not one CoT; and an Apache-2.0 repository label does not restore missing upstream provenance. OmniThought-0528 is a separate supplemental artifact rather than an implicit part of every main-release row.

核心贡献是一个轨迹池，其中答案接收、推理有效性判断、教师身份和两个过程描述量保持为不同变量。论文随后在 RV-CD 空间中为目标模型选择轨迹，而不是把所有答案正确的 CoT 视为可互换对象。

| 契约要素 | 公开或论文报告的对象 | |---|---| | 外层单位 | 一个 question 行 | | 嵌套单位 | 该行 reasoning 列表中的一条记录 | | 轨迹内容 | thought、solution，以及二者拼接的 full_response | | 生成者元数据 | teacher；ACL 正式版列出 DeepSeek-R1、DeepSeek-R1-0528 和 QwQ-32B | | 过程判断 | thought_correctness_verify，源自分别评估推理和解答的提示 | | RV 对象 | 0–9 的 level 与 judge；论文中的最终 RV 以 alpha=0.5 混合 judge 分数和归一化 token 长度 | | CD 对象 | 0–9 的 level 与 judge，描述复现该方法所需的认知能力 | | 发布布局 | 708,009 个外层行、单一 train split、135 个 Parquet shard、Apache-2.0 仓库元数据 | | 未提供 | 题源/领域、拒绝原因、验证轨迹、生成设置、运行 ID、train 之外的 split |

反馈契约有四层。第一，代码执行或数学/科学混合验证决定最终答案是否接收。第二，推理逻辑有效性另行记录，不控制保留。第三，QwQ-32B 给出整体 CD 和 judge 侧 RV 分数，最终 RV 还纳入长度。第四，下游实验把这些标注转换为选择概率、冗长度偏好对或学习得到的标量奖励项。

这种区分可避免若干类别错误：thought_correctness_verify=true 不是步骤级证明；RV/CD 差异不是正确性偏好；一个数据行不等于一条 CoT；Apache-2.0 仓库标签也不能补回缺失的上游来源。OmniThought-0528 是独立补充资产，不能默认视为每个主发布行的一部分。

title: Method
方法
html:
The ACL paper describes the following pipeline.

  1. Collect problems. Mathematics uses OpenMathReasoning, MathInstruct, DeepMath-103K, NuminaMath-1.5, and OpenThoughts2-1M. Code uses TACO, APPS, OpenThoughts2-1M, and OpenCodeReasoning. Science uses StackExchange Physics, StackExchange Biology, camel-ai/chemistry, and OpenThoughts2-1M.
  2. Deduplicate and screen overlap. Apply normalized Indel similarity and 10-gram similarity against AIME24, MATH500, LiveCodeBench V2, and GPQA-Diamond. Thresholds, removal counts, and decision logs are not reported.
  3. Generate candidates. DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-R1-0528, and QwQ-32B produce multiple CoTs per problem. Some candidates below 3,000 CoT tokens are randomly removed to reduce the share of simple items. Teacher allocation, requests per problem, decoding settings, seeds, and retry rules are unknown.
  4. Validate two outcomes. The released prompt asks a judge to return independent reasoning_valid and solution_valid booleans. Code solutions are executed against tests; math and science combine rules with LLM judgment. Only an incorrect final answer forces removal, so answer-correct but reasoning-invalid traces may remain. Each retained problem is reported to have at least two accepted candidates.
  5. Annotate process characteristics. QwQ-32B judges RV and CD on 0-9 scales. The final RV is round(alpha L_RV + (1-alpha) L_norm) with alpha=0.5, where L_norm is a log-normalized token length. CD rates the competence required to follow and reproduce the reasoning method. The release does not expose the raw judge RV, normalized-length component, tokenizer, or corpus extrema used in that calculation.
  6. Select for a student. For every problem, the paper scores candidates by whether CD stays within target capacity mu_CD and by the CD-RV gap. It normalizes the two components and mixes them with beta=0.5 by default. More than one high-probability trace may be sampled per problem; exact selected manifests for the released models are absent.

The paper evaluates three reuse paths. On matched 10K-problem sets, SFT compares random, RV-only, CD-only, and combined selection. DPO chooses RV 3–5 traces and rejects the maximum-RV trace for the same problem, creating a verbosity preference rather than a correctness preference. GRPO trains RV/CD reward models, normalizes their predicted scores to [0,1], and adds them to format and accuracy rewards; reward weights and rollout-generation settings are not disclosed.

Appendix D provides training scaffolds: the RQ SFT, DPO, and GRPO studies use 8 A800-80GB GPUs, while strong 7B/8B and 32B SFT uses 64 A800-80GB GPUs. The paper footnote points to EasyDistill, and the current repository contains a ThoughtX README, a simple RV/CD filter, and an example training config. At commit acbe49b5d9b16b3beb874528056e11dfdfac6d1c, that example targets a 1.5B student with a 4K sequence length, so it is a partial scaffold rather than a frozen reproduction of the paper's construction and 7B/32B runs.

ACL 论文描述了以下流水线。

  1. 收集问题。 数学来源为 OpenMathReasoning、MathInstruct、DeepMath-103K、NuminaMath-1.5 和 OpenThoughts2-1M；代码来源为 TACO、APPS、OpenThoughts2-1M 和 OpenCodeReasoning；科学来源为 StackExchange Physics、StackExchange Biology、camel-ai/chemistry 和 OpenThoughts2-1M。
  2. 去重与重叠筛查。 针对 AIME24、MATH500、LiveCodeBench V2 和 GPQA-Diamond 使用归一化 Indel 相似度与 10-gram 相似度。阈值、移除数量和决策日志未报告。
  3. 生成候选。 DeepSeek-R1、DeepSeek-R1-0528 和 QwQ-32B 为每个问题生成多条 CoT。为减少简单题占比，部分 CoT 少于 3,000 token 的候选被随机移除。教师分配、每题请求数、解码设置、随机种子和重试规则均未知。
  4. 分别验证两个结果。 公开提示要求 judge 独立返回 reasoning_valid 与 solution_valid 两个布尔值。代码解答通过测试执行；数学和科学结合规则与 LLM 判断。只有最终答案错误才强制移除，因此答案正确但推理无效的轨迹可能保留。论文称每个保留问题至少有两条被接收候选。
  5. 标注过程特征。 QwQ-32B 按 0–9 评分 RV 与 CD。最终 RV 为 round(alpha L_RV + (1-alpha) L_norm)，alpha=0.5，其中 L_norm 是对数归一化 token 长度。CD 评估理解并复现该推理方法所需的能力。发布中没有公开原始 judge RV、归一化长度分量、所用 tokenizer 或计算时的语料极值。
  6. 面向学生模型选择。 论文针对每个问题，依据 CD 是否处于目标能力 mu_CD 范围内及 CD-RV 间距给候选打分，再对两项归一化，并默认以 beta=0.5 混合。每题可以抽取多条高概率轨迹；公开模型所用的精确选择清单缺失。

论文评估三条复用路径。在匹配的 10K 问题集上，SFT 比较随机、仅 RV、仅 CD 和联合选择。DPO 把 RV 3–5 的轨迹设为 chosen，把同题最大 RV 轨迹设为 rejected；这形成的是冗长度偏好，而非正确性偏好。GRPO 训练 RV/CD reward model，把预测分数归一化到 [0,1]，并与格式奖励、准确性奖励相加；奖励权重和 rollout 生成设置未披露。

附录 D 给出训练 scaffold：研究问题中的 SFT、DPO 和 GRPO 使用 8 张 A800-80GB GPU，强模型的 7B/8B 与 32B SFT 使用 64 张 A800-80GB GPU。论文脚注指向 EasyDistill；当前仓库含 ThoughtX README、简单 RV/CD 过滤脚本和示例训练配置。在提交 acbe49b5d9b16b3beb874528056e11dfdfac6d1c 上，该示例面向 1.5B 学生且序列长度为 4K，因此只是部分 scaffold，不是论文构造过程和 7B/32B 运行的冻结复现。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The artifact evidence is unusually concrete at the schema level. The pinned official README declares 708,009 train rows and 135 Parquet shards; each outer row contains a question and a list of reasoning records. The paper reports more than two million nested CoTs. Hugging Face's datasets-server currently marks its processing as partial, with only 47,277 counted rows and a 552,229-row estimate; that partial estimate must not replace the release metadata, while the exact nested total still requires a full-snapshot count.

The matched 10K-problem selection study in Table 2 separates several policies:

| SFT trace selection | AIME2024 | MATH500 | GPQA-Diamond | LiveCodeBench V2 | Average | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Random | 16.67 | 80.6 | 36.36 | 31.31 | 41.24 | | RV optimal | 26.67 | 83.2 | 40.40 | 34.44 | 46.18 | | CD optimal | 33.33 | 83.8 | 39.90 | 36.10 | 48.28 | | Combined | 36.67 | 84.4 | 40.91 | 36.59 | 49.64 |

Because the problems and SFT configuration are held fixed, this supports a selection effect within that study. It does not prove that the scores are universally calibrated or that every selected trace is logically valid.

The DPO experiment uses 10K verbosity pairs. It leaves AIME2024 unchanged at 36.67, raises MATH500 from 84.4 to 86.2, GPQA-Diamond from 40.91 to 42.93, and LiveCodeBench V2 from 36.59 to 39.9, while reducing average output tokens on all four benchmarks. This is evidence for shaping output verbosity under the paper's pairing rule, not for learning human correctness preferences.

Table 4 provides an RL ablation without prior CoT SFT on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Vanilla GRPO reports MATH500/AIME2024 of 78.8/13.3; adding RV gives 79.0/16.7, CD gives 80.8/20.0, and both give 81.4/23.3. The raw model is 73.6/10.0. These results support the reported reward additions in that setup, but the missing reward weights, rollout policy, and verifier implementation prevent exact attribution or reproduction.

Capacity-conditioned selection is model-dependent as claimed: Table 7 reports the best average at mu_CD=5 for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (63.4 versus 55.5 on the full dataset) and at mu_CD=7 for Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (77.6 versus 72.8). The 10K-CoT judge audit reports QwQ-32B mean absolute differences from human ratings of 1.22 for RV and 1.17 for CD; differences from DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-R1-0528 are also below 2. This is a limited consistency check, not exact agreement or comprehensive calibration. None of the benchmark results alone proves data correctness, provenance quality, decontamination, or reuse safety.

在 schema 层面，公开资产证据较为具体。固定 revision 的官方 README 声明单一 train split 有 708,009 行和 135 个 Parquet shard；每个外层行包含一道问题及一个推理记录列表。论文报告嵌套 CoT 超过两百万条。Hugging Face datasets-server 当前明确标记处理结果为 partial，只统计了 47,277 行并估算为 552,229 行；这一部分估算不能替代发布元数据，而精确嵌套总数仍需对完整快照计算。

表 2 在匹配的 10K 问题上区分了多种选择策略：

| SFT 轨迹选择 | AIME2024 | MATH500 | GPQA-Diamond | LiveCodeBench V2 | 平均值 | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | 随机 | 16.67 | 80.6 | 36.36 | 31.31 | 41.24 | | RV 最优 | 26.67 | 83.2 | 40.40 | 34.44 | 46.18 | | CD 最优 | 33.33 | 83.8 | 39.90 | 36.10 | 48.28 | | 联合 | 36.67 | 84.4 | 40.91 | 36.59 | 49.64 |

由于问题集合和 SFT 配置保持不变，这支持该实验内部存在选择效应；但它不能证明评分具有普适校准，也不能证明每条选中轨迹的逻辑都有效。

DPO 实验使用 10K 个冗长度偏好对。AIME2024 保持 36.67 不变；MATH500 从 84.4 升至 86.2，GPQA-Diamond 从 40.91 升至 42.93，LiveCodeBench V2 从 36.59 升至 39.9；四个 benchmark 的平均输出 token 均下降。这是论文配对规则下调节输出冗长度的证据，不是学习人类正确性偏好的证据。

表 4 对未做 CoT SFT 的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 给出 RL 消融。Vanilla GRPO 的 MATH500/AIME2024 为 78.8/13.3；加入 RV 后为 79.0/16.7，加入 CD 后为 80.8/20.0，同时加入二者后为 81.4/23.3；原始模型为 73.6/10.0。这支持所报告奖励项在该设置中的作用，但缺失的奖励权重、rollout 策略和验证器实现阻止精确归因与复现。

按能力选择确实表现出模型依赖性：表 7 中，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在 mu_CD=5 时平均分最高，为 63.4，而全量数据为 55.5；Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 在 mu_CD=7 时最高，为 77.6，而全量数据为 72.8。10K CoT 的 judge 审计中，QwQ-32B 相对人类评分的平均绝对差为 RV 1.22、CD 1.17；相对 DeepSeek-R1 和 DeepSeek-R1-0528 的差异也都低于 2。这只是有限一致性检查，不是精确一致或完整校准。任何 benchmark 结果本身都不能证明数据正确、来源可靠、无污染或可安全复用。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior open reasoning datasets already used teacher distillation, answer filtering, multiple candidates, LLM judges, and long-CoT SFT. OmniThought does not originate those components. Its more specific change is to retain several answer-valid candidates per problem, keep reasoning validity separate from answer acceptance, and annotate every retained trace with teacher identity plus two whole-trace descriptors intended for student-aware selection.

Reasoning Verbosity is not simply length: the paper combines a QwQ-32B judgment about whether the reasoning amount fits the problem with log-normalized token length. Cognitive Difficulty is not problem difficulty alone: it estimates the competence needed to follow and reproduce the chosen reasoning method. The downstream selection rule then uses a target capacity mu_CD and the CD-RV gap to sample traces for a particular student. This makes model capacity, trace method, and verbosity explicit construction variables rather than post-hoc observations.

The work also connects one release object to three training interfaces. SFT samples from the RV-CD space; DPO constructs within-problem verbosity pairs; GRPO learns scalar RV/CD predictors and adds their outputs to format and accuracy rewards. The value is the common metadata substrate and the controlled comparisons, not a claim that the three objectives share the same semantics. In particular, DPO's chosen/rejected relation is about desired verbosity, whereas GRPO's RV/CD terms are learned rewards.

The direction signal is conditional rather than universal. The reported optimum shifts from mu_CD=5 for a 7B student to 7 for a 32B student, and the paper's 100K-to-1.1M scaling table shows diminishing gains. Reuse should therefore validate the selection rule on the target model and domain. The contribution remains partly disclosed because generator settings, row-level source lineage, verifier assets, exact selected subsets, and a frozen end-to-end construction config are not available.

此前的开放推理数据已经使用教师蒸馏、答案过滤、多候选、LLM judge 和长 CoT SFT；OmniThought 并非首次提出这些组件。它更具体的变化，是为每个问题保留多条答案有效候选，把推理有效性与答案接收分开，并为每条保留轨迹记录教师身份及两个用于学生模型适配选择的整轨描述量。

Reasoning Verbosity 不等于简单长度：论文把 QwQ-32B 对“推理量是否适合该问题”的判断与对数归一化 token 长度结合。Cognitive Difficulty 也不只是题目难度：它估计理解并复现所选推理方法所需的能力。下游选择规则再使用目标能力 mu_CD 和 CD-RV 间距为特定学生采样轨迹。这样，模型能力、轨迹方法与冗长度成为显式构造变量，而不只是事后观察。

该工作还把同一个发布对象连接到三种训练接口。SFT 从 RV-CD 空间采样；DPO 构造同题冗长度偏好对；GRPO 学习标量 RV/CD 预测器，并把其输出加入格式奖励与准确性奖励。价值在于共享的元数据底座和受控比较，而不是声称三种目标语义相同。特别是，DPO 的 chosen/rejected 关系针对期望冗长度，GRPO 的 RV/CD 项则是学习得到的奖励。

这一方向信号具有条件性，不是普适规律。报告中的最优值从 7B 学生的 mu_CD=5 移到 32B 学生的 7；论文从 100K 到 1.1M 的扩展表也显示边际收益递减。因此，复用时应在目标模型和领域上重新验证选择规则。由于生成设置、逐行来源 lineage、验证器资产、精确训练子集和冻结的端到端构造配置均不可用，这项贡献仍属于部分披露。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Source lineage: The release schema has no prompt-source or domain field. Named source families and aggregate domains are known, but individual questions cannot be mapped back to an upstream revision or license from the released row alone.
  • Generation disclosure: Teacher identity is retained per accepted trace, yet teacher proportions, requests per problem, sampling temperature/top-p, maximum output, seeds, retries, original candidate count, and rejected generations are unavailable.
  • Retention semantics: The paper's validator separates reasoning validity and solution validity, but only an incorrect solution mandates removal. Consequently, answer-correct traces with locally invalid reasoning can remain. thought_correctness_verify is holistic and does not locate the first error.
  • Verifier replay: Code tests, runner versions, sandbox, timeouts, math/science normalization rules, LLM-judge model settings, and per-candidate evidence are not released. False acceptance and rejection rates are unknown.
  • RV construction: Final RV mixes a model judgment with token length. The release does not expose the raw judge component, normalized-length component, tokenizer, L_min, or L_max, so the displayed score cannot be recomputed exactly from the row.
  • CD/RV calibration: QwQ-32B is both a central dataset annotator and the reference in the reported audit. Mean absolute differences below 2 do not provide exact agreement, per-level confusion, domain calibration, uncertainty, or evidence that the same ranges fit unrelated students.
  • Selection bias: Randomly removing some traces below 3,000 tokens can suppress concise or easy examples. The removed fraction, seed, source distribution, and interaction with teacher style are undisclosed.
  • Release counting: The pinned README declares 708,009 problem rows and the paper reports more than two million CoTs. The datasets-server is partial and its 552,229 estimate is not authoritative. Exact nested counts, duplicates, and per-problem multiplicities still require a complete snapshot audit.
  • Decontamination: Normalized Indel and 10-gram methods are named, but thresholds, removed examples, normalization, generated-output screening, and residual-overlap measurements are absent.
  • Preference meaning: DPO selects RV 3–5 and rejects maximum-RV traces. This operationalizes a verbosity preference, not human preference, factuality, or correctness; both sides may be answer-valid.
  • RL reproducibility: The GRPO objective names format, accuracy, RV, and CD terms, but reward weights, reward-model training data details, rollout count, decoding, advantage settings, and executable verifier code are not fully reported.
  • Experimental attribution: The 10K studies control the problem set, but main-model comparisons change model family, selected traces, capacity target, training budget, and possibly snapshot. Benchmark gains are not proof of data quality.
  • Rights and ethics: Apache-2.0 repository metadata does not replace per-source terms. The paper also notes teacher-bias propagation and misleading reasoning in high-stakes deployment; privacy, source consent, and downstream safety require separate review.
  • Code completeness: EasyDistill is official and supplies a ThoughtX guide, filter script, and example config, but the checked example is a 1.5B/4K scaffold and does not freeze the complete construction or reported 7B/32B runs.
  • Version boundary: arXiv v1 describes two teachers and Qwen2.5 experiments, while the final ACL paper adds DeepSeek-R1-0528 and Qwen3 material. The ACL publication should be the primary recipe record; OmniThought-0528 remains a separate release.

• 来源 lineage： 发布 schema 没有题源或领域字段。虽然来源族和总体领域已知，但仅凭公开行无法把具体问题映射回上游 revision 或许可。
  • 生成披露： 每条被接收轨迹保留教师身份，但教师比例、每题请求数、采样 temperature/top-p、最大输出、随机种子、重试、原始候选数和被拒生成均不可用。
  • 保留语义： 论文验证器把推理有效性与解答有效性分开，但只有解答错误才强制移除。因此，答案正确但局部推理无效的轨迹可以保留；thought_correctness_verify 是整体判断，不能定位首个错误。
  • 验证器重放： 代码测试、runner 版本、sandbox、超时、数学/科学归一化规则、LLM judge 设置和逐候选证据未发布；假接收与假拒绝率未知。
  • RV 构造： 最终 RV 混合模型判断与 token 长度。发布没有提供原始 judge 分量、归一化长度分量、tokenizer、L_min 或 L_max，因此不能仅凭行内容精确重算显示分数。
  • CD/RV 校准： QwQ-32B 既是核心数据标注器，也是报告审计的参照对象。平均绝对差低于 2 不等于精确一致，也未提供逐级混淆、领域校准、不确定性或相同范围适配无关学生模型的证据。
  • 选择偏差： 随机移除部分少于 3,000 token 的轨迹，可能压低简洁或简单样本的占比；移除比例、随机种子、来源分布及其与教师风格的交互未披露。
  • 发布计数： 固定 revision 的 README 声明 708,009 个问题行，论文报告 CoT 超过两百万条。datasets-server 只完成部分处理，其 552,229 估算并非权威总数。精确嵌套数量、重复项与每题轨迹数仍需完整快照审计。
  • 去污染： 论文列出归一化 Indel 和 10-gram 方法，但没有阈值、移除样本、归一化细节、生成输出筛查或残余重叠测量。
  • 偏好含义： DPO 把 RV 3–5 设为 chosen，把最大 RV 设为 rejected。这操作化的是冗长度偏好，而非人类偏好、事实性或正确性；两侧都可能答案有效。
  • RL 可复现性： GRPO 目标列出格式、准确性、RV 和 CD 项，但奖励权重、reward model 训练数据细节、rollout 数、解码、advantage 设置和可执行验证代码均未完整报告。
  • 实验归因： 10K 实验控制了问题集合，但主模型比较同时改变模型家族、所选轨迹、能力目标、训练预算，可能还改变快照。benchmark 提升不能证明数据质量。
  • 权利与伦理： Apache-2.0 仓库元数据不能替代逐来源条款。论文还指出教师偏差传播与高风险部署中生成误导性推理的风险；隐私、来源同意和下游安全需单独审查。
  • 代码完整性： EasyDistill 是官方代码，提供 ThoughtX 指南、过滤脚本和示例配置；但核验到的示例只是 1.5B/4K scaffold，没有冻结完整构造过程或所报告的 7B/32B 运行。
  • 版本边界： arXiv v1 描述两位教师与 Qwen2.5 实验，ACL 正式版加入 DeepSeek-R1-0528 和 Qwen3 内容。应以 ACL 正式发表版作为主要配方记录；OmniThought-0528 仍是独立发布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track, OmniThought is useful as a worked example of turning a heterogeneous trace pool into several post-training data products while retaining some process metadata. It also shows why an open dataset can remain only partially auditable when source, verifier, and selection lineage are missing.

  • Nested-release processing: Pin revision 274ec6417efb435421fb222319d1bb47291ea69b, count outer questions and nested traces separately, preserve question grouping and teacher identity when flattening, and never treat the datasets-server's partial estimate as the official row total.
  • Conditional SFT/distillation: Reconstruct row-level source and license information, rerun correctness checks, decontaminate against the target evaluation set, then compare random, RV-only, CD-only, and combined selection at matched problems and trace counts. Re-estimate mu_CD for the actual student rather than copying 5 or 7.
  • Preference construction: Use within-problem pairs only with an explicit preference semantics. The paper's DPO pair means “preferred verbosity range versus maximum verbosity,” not “correct versus incorrect”; retain that label meaning in downstream schemas.
  • Reward-model/RL study: Treat RV and CD as judge-dependent targets, validate them against humans and alternative judges, report reward weights and correlations with length/teacher/domain, and preserve rollout/verifier logs. Online RLVR requires rebuilding the executable accuracy contract.
  • Verifier audit: Stratify samples by domain, teacher, RV, CD, and thought_correctness_verify; replay code tests and independently inspect math/science answers and intermediate reasoning to measure false accepts and false rejects.
  • Release engineering: Add immutable prompt-source revisions, domain/license fields, generation job IDs, all candidates, filter decisions, raw/final RV components, selected-subset manifests, and checkpoint hashes.

Reuse class: the paper and Card are strong construction/audit references; the public dataset is conditionally suitable for SFT, distillation, preference construction, or reward modeling only after revision, rights, correctness, and contamination checks; it is not a clean evaluation set. EasyDistill can bootstrap loading, filtering, and training, but does not currently reproduce the complete construction pipeline. Benchmark gains are behavioral evidence under reported settings, not proof that every released trace is correct or reusable.

对于指定的 Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track，OmniThought 是一个完整案例：它把异构轨迹池转换为多类后训练数据产品，同时保留部分过程元数据。它也说明，即使数据集已经开放，只要来源、验证器和选择 lineage 缺失，审计仍可能不完整。

  • 嵌套发布处理： 固定 revision 274ec6417efb435421fb222319d1bb47291ea69b，分别统计外层问题与嵌套轨迹；展开数据时保留问题分组和教师身份；绝不能把 datasets-server 的部分估算当作官方行总数。
  • 有条件 SFT/蒸馏： 重建逐行来源和许可信息，重新运行正确性检查，针对目标评测集去污染，然后在问题数和轨迹数匹配的条件下比较随机、仅 RV、仅 CD 和联合选择。应为实际学生模型重新估计 mu_CD，而不是直接复制 5 或 7。
  • 偏好构造： 只有在明确偏好语义时才使用同题配对。论文 DPO 对表示“期望冗长度范围对最大冗长度”，不是“正确对错误”；下游 schema 必须保留这一标签含义。
  • Reward model/RL 研究： 把 RV 与 CD 视为依赖 judge 的目标，使用人类和替代 judge 重新验证，报告奖励权重及其与长度、教师、领域的相关性，并保存 rollout/验证日志。在线 RLVR 需要重建可执行准确性契约。
  • 验证器审计： 按领域、教师、RV、CD 和 thought_correctness_verify 分层抽样；重放代码测试，并独立检查数学/科学答案与中间推理，以测量假接收和假拒绝。
  • 发布工程： 增加不可变题源 revision、领域/许可字段、生成 job ID、全部候选、过滤决策、原始/最终 RV 分量、所选子集清单和 checkpoint hash。

复用等级：论文与本卡适合作为构造和审计参考；公开数据集只有在完成版本、权利、正确性和污染检查后，才有条件用于 SFT、蒸馏、偏好构造或 reward modeling；它不是干净评测集。EasyDistill 可用于启动加载、过滤与训练，但目前不能复现完整构造流水线。benchmark 提升只是报告设置下的行为证据，不能证明每条发布轨迹都正确或可复用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 3 and Appendices A-C together: the release unit is a question with nested candidates, and answer acceptance is separate from thought_correctness_verify.
  • Use the pinned README count of 708,009 outer train rows; the datasets-server's 552,229 figure is a partial estimate. The exact nested CoT total remains unverified beyond the paper's “more than two million” claim.
  • Read Equations 1-2 before interpreting RV: final RV mixes QwQ-32B judgment and log-normalized token length at alpha=0.5; the released row does not expose both components.
  • Read Tables 2-4 with their data contracts: combined selection is a matched-problem SFT result, DPO encodes verbosity preference, and GRPO adds learned RV/CD rewards whose full rollout settings are missing.
  • Pin the ACL paper, main dataset, OmniThought-0528, and EasyDistill separately. The final ACL version adds DeepSeek-R1-0528/Qwen3 material, while the checked code is a partial scaffold rather than a frozen construction manifest.

• 应把第 3 节与附录 A–C 一起阅读：发布单位是包含嵌套候选的问题，答案接收与 thought_correctness_verify 分开。
  • 外层 train 行数应采用固定 README 的 708,009；datasets-server 的 552,229 是部分估算。嵌套 CoT 精确总数仍未独立验证，只能保留论文“超过两百万”的口径。
  • 解释 RV 前先读公式 1–2：最终 RV 以 alpha=0.5 混合 QwQ-32B 判断与对数归一化 token 长度；公开行没有暴露两个分量。
  • 阅读表 2–4 时应同时保留数据契约：联合选择是匹配问题的 SFT 结果，DPO 编码冗长度偏好，GRPO 加入学习得到的 RV/CD 奖励，但完整 rollout 设置缺失。
  • ACL 论文、主数据集、OmniThought-0528 和 EasyDistill 必须分别固定版本。ACL 正式版加入 DeepSeek-R1-0528/Qwen3 内容；核验到的代码只是部分 scaffold，不是冻结的构造清单。
